title: You took steroids, is it now too late?
summary: Answering a former steroid user who asked if he can ever join the Noble Natties, NH holds that ex-users can never call themselves natural again but can become noble through repentance and action. He argues that being natural is only a baseline, that pride must be earned through training and virtue, and that an elitist movement which shuts out repentant users would fail.
claims: Staying natural is the core message of the channel; he sees the natural way as the supreme way to live as a lifter and picked the channel name for it
Natural lifting has to look strong and attractive to win people; you cannot convince anyone to stay natural without impressive physiques to show for it
Being natural is a baseline, not an achievement; nobody deserves a pat on the back just for not taking drugs
Anyone who has taken PEDs can never call themselves natural again; the rule exists so users cannot cycle off for a few months and sell to naturals as fake natties
A repentant ex-user can still become a Noble Natty, because the noble part (virtue and action) matters more than natural status
Earlier natural movements on fitness YouTube failed because being born natural takes no effort, so it cannot generate pride or cohesion on its own
There is no pride in being natural with no physique; a skinny, untrained natty actually advertises for the PED camp
Being noble is a set of actions, not a state of existence; natural status is binary and only concerns what you have or have not done
A repentant ex-user who trains and promotes a virtuous life is more of a Noble Natty than a natural who sits on his couch playing Fortnite
Everyone deserves a second chance on two conditions: they ask for it and they make efforts
He admits he may have been one bad day away from taking drugs himself and would have wanted to be welcomed back
Closing the door on ex-users pushes them back toward steroid users; the movement must never turn elitist or gatekeep, except against people joining to destroy it
Many viewers told him they were about to take drugs and he talked them out of it; the tempted are the people the movement must help most
Repentant ex-users are the most effective soldiers against PEDs, like former addicts giving talks in schools, because they lived the temptation
Naturals on YouTube who promote or tempt people toward drug use do more damage than repentant ex-users and are not his brothers
Ex-users should forgive themselves and turn their regret into energy for keeping young men off the same path
Pride that comes from identity alone, especially unearned identity, turns into arrogance; real pride is built through action
